subject: Kickoff: invariant explanations / meta-model audits
body: Team — kickoff for invariant-explanations in the vision portfolio. The core idea from our release: train meta-models that predict the predictions of an entire class of base-models trained under different hparam settings, without fully training those base-models. Covariates are either X,H (sample images plus hparams) or X,W@epoch (samples plus base-model weights at an early epoch); targets are the base-model predictions at the final epoch, 86, of the CNN zoo. Product angle: hparam-sensitivity audits — telling a vision team whether their model's behavior on a given input is stable across the hparam class, before they burn a training run. Milestones: repro on the accompanying sample weights/metrics by end of April; full-zoo training in May; audit-tool prototype decision by end of June. Ivo has the staffing pen. — Lucia
